entities.name: UbiE Q8D382
observations: The 250-aa query sequence is an exact full-length sequence match to reviewed UniProt Q8D382, Ubiquinone/menaquinone biosynthesis C-methyltransferase UbiE from Wigglesworthia glossinidia brevipalpis.
Annotated as SAM-dependent C-methyltransferase for demethylmenaquinol-to-menaquinol and DDMQH2-to-DMQH2 conversions; EC 2.1.1.163 and EC 2.1.1.201.

entities.name: UbiE menaquinol methylation
observations: 2-demethylmenaquinol + S-adenosyl-L-methionine → menaquinol + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H+; Rhea RHEA:42640.
